paragraphs.source_en: As Ieyasu listened beside him to Hideyoshi issuing his instructions, he could not help reflecting: surely there should be no tragedy in this world so absurd. Everyone obeyed the orders of a Taikō gone mad and set tens of thousands of men to work... Yet the three commissioners who received those orders appeared to harbor no doubts at all. Everyone took it as only natural, and that very day the whole place erupted into frantic activity.
